component.name: logging
component.description: TAPPaaS module logging: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). Loki + Alloy + Grafana on NixOS; Grafana :3000 published via Caddy to the mgmt zone only, nginx fronts Loki on :3100 (admin credential) and :3101 (per-VM push credential), Alloy takes syslog on 1514/1515. Verified live: libxslt is in the closure only because nginx is built with --with-http_xslt_module; the generated nginx.conf contains no xslt directive, and nginx links libxml2 2.15.4, which carries the upstream mitigation for CVE-2025-7425.

analysis.detail: libxslt is only linked into nginx's built-in xslt filter, and the logging nginx.conf has no xslt_stylesheet directive, so no XSLT is ever run; the libxml2 it links (2.15.4) also carries the upstream mitigation (>= 2.14.5).
